## Why it is a separate file

The LGPL lets this game keep its own licence *provided* the library stays
replaceable: kept whole and unmodified, loaded as its own script, and
possible for someone to swap for their own build. So it is never bundled
or minified into our code, and nothing here is edited. Changes we need go
in `assets/avatar.js`, which is ours.

## What the author asks beyond the licence

From the top of `LICENSE.md`:

> you can use it however you want, but the library itself and any assets
> you create for it has to be freely accessible. i.e. I can pull it back
> into the standard library

So any body parts, clothing or patterns authored for it should stay
freely available — broader than the licence text requires, and clearly
the intent. Worth honouring.
